sourceNote: Moderate-to-hard running block. Start it only if you can already run 5 km without stopping. Efforts use RPE on a 1–10 scale.

logModes.distance: Distance in km plus the time it took; pace is derived.

blockTypes.warmup: Low-intensity preparation before the main work.
blockTypes.intervals: Repeated hard efforts with timed recoveries.
blockTypes.conditioning: Short, fast running such as strides.
blockTypes.cooldown: Easy running to bring the session down.

weeks.title: Base Camp
weeks.focus: Settle into five sessions a week and find your easy, tempo and interval efforts.

days.name: Easy Run
days.instructions: Fully conversational. If you can't speak in full sentences, slow down.

exercises.name: Easy Run
exercises.instructions: Easy days build the aerobic base that the hard days draw on. Keep it honest.

days.name: Intervals
days.instructions: Hard day. Aim for even splits — the last rep should match the first.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instructions: Start slower than feels necessary. The session only works if you arrive warm.

exercises.name: Leg Swings
exercises.instructions: Front to back, then side to side. Hold a wall for balance. Alternate sides each set.

exercises.name: A-Skips
exercises.instructions: Quick, light contacts. Drive the knee up and land under your hips.

exercises.name: Strides
exercises.instructions: Accelerate smoothly to fast-but-relaxed, then walk back. Not a sprint.

blocks.name: 6 × 400 m
blocks.instructions: Jog or walk the 90 sec recovery. The rest timer is your recovery clock.

exercises.name: 400 m Repeat
exercises.instructions: Roughly your best 3 km effort. Quick turnover, relaxed shoulders.

exercises.name: Cool-down Jog
exercises.instructions: Let your breathing come all the way down before you stop.

days.name: Rest
days.instructions: Full rest or an easy walk. No running.

days.name: Tempo Run
days.instructions: Comfortably hard: you can say a few words, not hold a conversation.

blocks.name: Tempo
blocks.instructions: Lock into one effort and hold it. Don't race the first kilometre.

exercises.name: Tempo Run
exercises.instructions: Around the pace you could hold for an hour-long race.

exercises.name: Cool-down Jog
exercises.instructions: Let your breathing come all the way down before you stop.

days.name: Runner Strength
days.instructions: Controlled reps, bodyweight or light dumbbells. This is durability work, not a max-effort lift.

exercises.name: Easy Jog or Bike
exercises.instructions: Just enough to feel warm.

blocks.name: Single-Leg Strength
blocks.instructions: Finish all sets of one exercise before moving on.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.instructions: Front shin close to vertical; lower under control for 3 seconds.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
exercises.instructions: Hinge at the hip with a flat back. Keep hips square to the floor.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
exercises.instructions: Full range off a step: pause at the top, 3 seconds down.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
exercises.instructions: Drive through the heel and keep the pelvis level.

exercises.name: Front Plank
exercises.instructions: Ribs down, glutes squeezed. Stop the set when your hips sag.

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.instructions: Straight line from ear to ankle. Alternate sides each set.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.instructions: Lower back stays pressed into the floor throughout.

days.name: Long Run
days.instructions: Time on feet is the goal. Carry water past 75 minutes and start slower than you want to.

exercises.name: Long Run
exercises.instructions: Hold back early. You should finish feeling you could run a little further.

days.name: Rest
days.instructions: Full rest. Eat well and get to bed early.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
exercises.instructions: Full range off a step: pause at the top, 3 seconds down.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
exercises.instructions: Drive through the heel and keep the pelvis level.

exercises.name: Front Plank
exercises.instructions: Ribs down, glutes squeezed. Stop the set when your hips sag.

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.instructions: Straight line from ear to ankle. Alternate sides each set.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.instructions: Lower back stays pressed into the floor throughout.

days.name: Long Run
days.instructions: Time on feet is the goal. Carry water past 75 minutes and start slower than you want to.

exercises.name: Long Run
exercises.instructions: Hold back early. You should finish feeling you could run a little further.

exercises.name: Steady Finish
exercises.instructions: Lift the effort for the final stretch without sprinting. Practise running well when tired.

days.name: Rest
days.instructions: Full rest. Eat well and get to bed early.

weeks.title: Taper & Test
weeks.focus: Volume drops so you arrive fresh. Finish the block with an all-out 10K time trial.

days.name: Easy Run
days.instructions: Fully conversational. If you can't speak in full sentences, slow down.

exercises.name: Easy Run
exercises.instructions: Easy days build the aerobic base that the hard days draw on. Keep it honest.

blocks.name: Strides

exercises.name: Strides
exercises.instructions: Accelerate smoothly to fast-but-relaxed. Stay tall and loose.

days.name: Sharpener
days.instructions: Hard day. Aim for even splits — the last rep should match the first.

blocks.name: Warm-up

exercises.name: Strides
exercises.instructions: Accelerate smoothly to fast-but-relaxed, then walk back. Not a sprint.

blocks.name: 4 × 400 m
blocks.instructions: Jog or walk the 120 sec recovery. The rest timer is your recovery clock.

exercises.instructions: Let your breathing come all the way down before you stop.
